time_to_evidence: every site-ci run before the immutable Netcup artifact is exported
purpose: Turn excellence into a fail-closed, evidence-bearing contract. Repeating the gate 100 times compounds regression coverage instead of creating 100 manual reviews.

authority.runtime: Cloudflare public edge in front of the nginx/Netcup origin (confenge-nginx-node/v2)

scoring.blocked_external_blocks_ci_or_promotion_: BLOCKED_EXTERNAL dimensions (e.g. trust-proof, issue #328) cannot be cleared by any code PR, so they no longer hard-fail the required site-ci check or the Netcup promotion gate that reuses it. They are still fully measured, reported and withhold the global 10/10 claim.

census.source: all visitor-facing source HTML derived by scripts/site/public_copy_scope.py
census.rule: source and artifact route sets must agree exactly; the manifest must equal the index.html route class derived from source, after named non-visitor exemptions
